MDIA 100.description: Investigation of media objects shaped by algorithms, through a balance of foundational concepts and hands-on experimentation. Examines perspectives on aesthetics, the impact of technology on media, and ethics.

MDIA 150.description: Media engagement with community partners through data, narrative and visual processes. Prerequisite: Restricted to BMS students with 1st year standing.

MDIA 270.description: Selected topics in media studies. Not offered every year. Restricted to BMS students.

MDIA 290.description: Development and practice of media group production processes. Restricted to BMS students with 2nd year standing or above.

MDIA 299.description: Investigation of readings and research undertaking topics of media studies, with the agreement, and under the supervision, of a faculty member with relevant expertise. Restricted to BMS students with approval from the Program Chair.

MDIA 300.course_name: Approaches to Writing for Media Studies
MDIA 300.description: Interdisciplinary perspectives of thematic topics in contemporary media and related theory with focused attention on writing practices. Restricted to B.M.S. students with third-year standing. Prerequisite: ENGL_V 232.

MDIA 350.description: Collaborative planning and activation of media interfaces for stakeholders informed by multidisciplinary approaches. Prerequisite: MDIA_V 290. Restricted to BMS students with 3rd year standing or higher.

MDIA 450.description: Advanced media works created in collaboration with community partners for public impact. Prerequisite: MDIA_V 350. Restricted to BMS students with 4th year standing.

MDIA 470.description: Selected topics in media studies. Not offered every year. Prerequisite: Restricted to students with 3rd year standing or higher.

MDIA 490.description: The roles and responsibilities of media producers as agents of transformation, with a focus on the student's own media decisions and artefacts. Prerequisite: MDIA_V 350. Restricted to BMS students with 4th year standing.

MDIA 499.description: Advanced research undertaking topics of media studies, with the agreement and under the supervision, of a faculty member with relevant expertise. Prerequisite: Restricted to BMS students with approval from the Program Chair.
